name: sealos
description: Deploy and operate Sealos Cloud apps through one interactive skill and a Brain managed workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy and operate apps on Sealos Cloud
interface.longDescription: Use Sealos to deploy from the template store, container images, or source code; provision cloud databases and S3-compatible storage; inspect and troubleshoot workloads. Brain managed mode uses its dedicated deploy and Kaniko skills.
defaultPrompt: Deploy this repo to Sealos Cloud.
Deploy an app from the Sealos template store.
Create a Sealos database or private object storage bucket.
